- Target monthly tokens (ingress+egress): ~15M tokens/month to start, scaling to 50M in Q4 if pilot goes well.
- Budget band we can commit to for pilot: $2,500–$4,000 / month. That maps to a target unit price of roughly $166–$266 per 1M tokens.
- Workload mix (current best guess): chat features (main UX) + embeddings for semantic search + lightweight rerank on top of the search results.

Can you send a short proposed model composition (which Redwood model(s) for chat / embeddings / rerank), an expected per-1M cost per model, and a blended $/1M figure under two scenarios (pilot: 15M, scale: 50M)? Also include any levers we can pull to get to the low end ($166 / 1M).

Attaching a one-page internal note for context. Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Oliver — thanks for the clear signal, this is super actionable. I pulled together a concise proposal below and attached a short estimate + a token-budget workbook so you can tweak assumptions. TL;DR: we can plausibly hit the mid point (~$215 / 1M) with a few levers; reaching $166 / 1M will require heavier caching, a higher ratio of cheaper chat model traffic, or a short ramp commitment.

Assumptions (please confirm if different):
- Pilot traffic: 15M tokens/month. Average request length (prompt + completion) = 600 tokens.
- Embeddings: ~100k vectors/month (avg 512-d vectors), charged per 1k tokens equivalent in our price model.
- Rerank: lightweight per-request scoring, ~0.5M calls/month, small input sizes.

Proposed model composition (pilot / percent of tokens):
- Chat: 65% -> recommend chat-large-v2 (balanced quality & cost). Estimated list cost ~ $290 / 1M tokens.
- Chat (fallback/low-latency): 10% -> chat-medium-v1 for quick responses and to lower unit cost. Estimated ~$95 / 1M tokens.
- Embeddings: 20% (separate billing unit) -> embed-compact-1 (optimized for cost). Estimated ~$120 / 1M tokens-equivalent.
- Rerank / scoring: 5% -> rerank-light-1 (cheap per-call pricing). Estimated effective ~$40 / 1M tokens-equivalent.

Blended math (pilot, 15M):
- Weighted blended = 0.65*290 + 0.10*95 + 0.20*120 + 0.05*40 = $208 / 1M tokens (approx).
- Monthly pilot cost at 15M = 15 * $208 = $3,120 / month.

Scale scenario (50M, assume 20% of traffic shifts to chat-medium-v1 via latency routing and caching):
- Adjusted composition: chat-large 50%, chat-medium 25%, embeddings 20%, rerank 5% -> blended ~$170 / 1M -> monthly $8,500 at 50M.

Levers to reach the low end (~$166 / 1M):
- Aggressive prefix/KV caching on chat flows (Neha: see note below) to reduce repeated generation.
- Increase fallback to chat-medium-v1 for specific intents where exactiveness is not required.
- Quantize embeddings / use batched embedding calls + ANN caching for repeated queries.
- Commit to a 3-month pilot consumption band (we can offer stepped tier discounts at commit levels).

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm the assumptions above (avg token size, embedding counts).
2) Neha to validate caching feasibility and estimate % token reduction.
3) I’ll circulate a short written proposal (1–2 pages) with the formal pricing table and a suggested canary rollout.

Attaching: RDW-5421-pricing-estimate.pdf (2 pages), token-budget-breakdown.xlsx (workbook).

If that looks reasonable I can book a 30-min follow-up tomorrow or Thursday.

Best,
Soojin Lee

Quick technical notes from my side on the levers we discussed — I validated with infra: 

- Caching: For conversational flows where users re-open threads or repeat queries, we typically see 10–30% token savings with prefix/KV cache depending on repetition. If KiteLabs has a set of common prompts (search+refine), assume ~20% reduction conservatively.
- Batching & autoscale: For embeddings, batching 32–64 vectors reduces per-call overhead; we can suggest a client-side batching library use to reduce per-call cost.
- Rerank optimization: Move expensive scoring offline for top-k candidates where feasible; live rerank only the top 10 to cut cost.
- Model quantization: embed-compact-1 supports int8 quantized paths in our Dedicated plan — expect ~25% cost reduction for embeddings with negligible quality loss.

If the team is comfortable with a tech commitment (client-side batching + a small tagging change to enable caching keys), I estimate the following adjusted blended pilot price: 
- Pilot blended -> ~$180 / 1M tokens (with conservative 15% caching + embedding quantization applied).

I can sign up for the technical call and bring a short checklist (client-side changes, expected latency impact, metrics) so engineering can estimate implementation effort.

-Neha
